home.realBody: The forward pass, the backward pass, and one AdamW step are hand-written in TypeScript and tested tensor-for-tensor against PyTorch golden traces (forward < 1e-4, gradients < 5e-4). The CUDA kernels in the GPU panels compile and are verified against CPU references at this model's exact shapes. When you hover a heatmap cell, you read a real fp32 value.
home.deepBody: Every page speaks twice: an intuition track for engineers meeting transformers, and a full-depth track with the derivations — why √d_k, why softmax subtracts the max, why LayerNorm caches 1/σ, why Adam's first step is sign descent, why tiling cuts memory traffic 32×. Flip the switch anytime; flip the phase and the whole app mirrors into gradients.
home.footer: Tiny Shakespeare · GPT-2 architecture · trained in minutes on one consumer GPU · everything open in the repo
